body: Fixes #8538 Obsidian's CLI dispatcher treats any non-`--` token as a command name, so the shipped `-disable-gpu` in `config/obsidian/user-flags.conf` breaks `obsidian --version` when CLI is enabled. Chromium itself accepts both `-` and `--`; this does not change GPU behaviour. Based on `quattro` (4.x).
